title: Pocketwire Business Profile Chargeback Fee Scale by Claim Amount
content:
The claim-size chargeback fee on a Pocketwire Business Profile follows the claim amount recorded on the buyer claim opened on the chargeback's sale.

| Claim amount | Claim-size chargeback fee |
|---|---|
| below USD 100.00 | the ratio-adjusted chargeback fee multiplied by 0.5, rounded down to whole dollars |
| at least USD 100.00 but below USD 250.00 | the ratio-adjusted chargeback fee multiplied by 0.75, rounded down to whole dollars |
| USD 250.00 or more | the ratio-adjusted chargeback fee as it is |

**Formal statement.** For a claim below 100.00 dollars the ratio-adjusted chargeback fee is multiplied by 0.5 and rounded down to whole dollars; for a claim of at least 100.00 but below 250.00 dollars it is multiplied by 0.75 and rounded down to whole dollars; for a larger claim it is kept as it is.

## Worked figures (hypothetical ratio-adjusted fee of USD 38.00)

| Claim amount | Claim-size chargeback fee |
|---|---|
| USD 99.99 | 19.00, so USD 19.00 |
| USD 100.00 | 28.50, rounded down to USD 28.00 |
| USD 249.99 | USD 28.00 |
| USD 250.00 | USD 38.00 |
